description: Pattern-based prevention rules for LobsterWars — TypeScript + Phaser + Matter.js multiplayer game

rules.name: Server trusts client-sent gameplay values
rules.message: Server reads client-sent gameplay value with fallback — client can send arbitrary values to cheat
rules.suggestion: Server must authoritatively calculate all gameplay-critical values. Never accept damage/health/speed from client input.

rules.name: WebSocket server without authentication
rules.message: WebSocket server accepts connections without authentication — any client can join
rules.suggestion: Require auth token on WebSocket connection: verify JWT/session before accepting connection

rules.name: CORS wildcard in server config
rules.message: CORS wildcard origin — allows any website to connect to the game server

rules.name: In-memory matchmaking state
rules.message: Matchmaking/room state stored in memory only — lost on server restart, no persistence
rules.suggestion: Use Redis or database for matchmaking state persistence: store active matches, queue, and player sessions

rules.name: setTimeout for game physics
rules.message: setTimeout used for game physics/timing — projectiles and gameplay resolved by timer instead of physics loop
rules.suggestion: Use a fixed-timestep server game loop (e.g., setInterval(1000/60) or requestAnimationFrame) for physics simulation

rules.name: Disconnect handler without reconnection support
rules.message: Disconnect handler immediately removes player — no reconnection grace period or session persistence
rules.suggestion: Add reconnection: keep session for 30s grace period, allow reconnect with session token, then remove

rules.name: TypeScript: any type in server code
rules.message: Usage of 'any' type in server code — loses type safety on network boundary
rules.suggestion: Define proper interfaces for all client messages and server state objects

rules.name: Matter.js physics body without collision category
rules.message: Matter.js body created without collisionFilter — may collide with everything including own projectiles
rules.suggestion: Set collisionFilter: { category, mask, group } to control what each body collides with

rules.name: Phaser scene without preload for assets
rules.message: Phaser Scene class without preload() method — assets not loaded before scene starts
rules.suggestion: Add preload() method and load all assets with this.load.image/spriteSheet/audio()
